statement: AGENTS.md requires an algorithmic divergence to carry a durable rationale plus differential and performance evidence. Each port-map row classified algorithmic has exactly one entry: its differential command (or why none can apply), its performance rows in the qualified engine or integrated reports (or why none can apply), or the owner porting it back to the source algorithm.

differential.scope: exact address-independent Theap random state for split, zero-result retry, forced weak initialization and strong reinitialization against pinned C

performance.scope: Theap random initialization on the first allocation of every installed product

differential.scope: the same M1 random state trace

performance.scope: Theap random initialization on the first allocation

differential.scope: 108 ordered heap-list, count, statistics and key fields of mi_heap_new/delete/destroy on a child-subprocess thread

performance.blocked: no equivalent opaque C/Rust boundary measures mi_heap_destroy or subprocess destruction: engine-api.h has no heap or subprocess entries, and its Rust backend (engine-rust-backend.rs, owned by alloc-perf) would need matching ones

differential.not_applicable: pinned C faults on this path (its oracle exits with SIGSEGV writing the first free-list link into PROT_NONE), so no equivalence differential exists; the Rust unit tests prove the corrected commit order

performance.not_applicable: reached only with the non-default disallow_arena_alloc and page_commit_on_demand options, which no measured or qualified configuration selects

src/page-map.c:mi-page-map-init-once-pro.disposition: port the source cold-root recovery back to pinned C behavior

src/heap.c:main-subprocess-non-main-heap.disposition: port the source main-Heap in-place realloc reuse back to pinned C behavior
